4. INSTALL TANK PLATE
Insert the tank plates from both ends in the direction of the arrows. Insert to where the portions marked "*" make contact with the tank.

5. STAKE CLAW OF TANK PLATE
(a) Set the punch on SST to "LOW."
SST 09230-00010

(b) Stake the claws of the tank plates with SST in the numerical order shown in the figure.
SST 09230-00010

NOTICE: If the bottom of the core plate is staked with SST on the guide block stopper, it may result in water leakage.
SST 09230-00010

HINT:
• Stake with just enough pressure to leave a mark on the claw. The staked plate height "B" should be as follows:
Plate height: 9.18 — 9.53 mm (0.3614 — 0.3752 in.)
